name: Glow Border Button
description: A button whose border carries a travelling beam of light (border beam); Copia adds a blurred halo that bleeds outside the edge and a beam that smoothly speeds up on hover or keyboard focus without restarting its lap.

props.name: size
props.description: Length of the beam in px.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one lap at rest.

props.name: hoverSpeed
props.description: Lap speed multiplier while hovered or focused; eases in and out.

props.name: glow
props.description: Blur radius of the outer halo in px; 0 turns it off.
